stories.headline: Use _meta annotation to prevent large MCP tool results from being truncated
stories.summary: Claude Code now supports preserving large tool results (like database schemas) up to 500K characters by adding a special metadata annotation. This prevents important data from being cut off during processing.
actionable_steps: Add `_meta["anthropic/maxResultSizeChars"]` annotation to your MCP tool result
Set the value to your desired character limit (up to 500,000)
Test with large results like database schemas to verify they pass through completely

stories.headline: Enable Amazon Bedrock support with Mantle integration
stories.summary: Claude Code v2.1.94 added support for Amazon Bedrock through Mantle integration. This allows you to use Claude Code with Amazon's Bedrock service instead of the default API endpoints, potentially offering better performance or compliance for enterprise users.
actionable_steps: Set the environment variable CLAUDE_CODE_USE_MANTLE=1 in your system or terminal
Restart Claude Code to apply the new configuration
Verify the connection is working by running a test query

stories.headline: Use @-mentions to give Claude Code precise file context
stories.summary: Boris Cherny, creator of Claude Code, recommends using @-mentions to point Claude at specific files instead of letting it search. This dramatically reduces token usage and improves accuracy since Claude works with the exact files you intend rather than guessing from project structure.
actionable_steps: Type @ in Claude Code to see a file picker with fuzzy search
Select the specific files relevant to your task before writing your prompt
Combine multiple @-mentions for cross-file tasks like refactoring

stories.headline: Use `/tui fullscreen` for flicker-free Claude Code rendering
stories.summary: The `/tui fullscreen` command switches Claude Code to a flicker-free rendering mode within the same conversation. This improves visual stability and reduces screen flicker during interactions.
actionable_steps: Press Enter to activate flicker-free rendering mode

stories.headline: Add session tracking header for proxy aggregation
stories.summary: Use the `X-Claude-Code-Session-Id` header in your API requests to help proxies group requests by session without needing to parse request bodies. This improves routing and monitoring capabilities when using Claude Code through proxy servers.
actionable_steps: Add the `X-Claude-Code-Session-Id` header to your Claude Code API requests
Set the header value to your session identifier
Configure your proxy to use this header for request aggregation instead of body parsing
